headline: JSW Cement Limited: Monitoring Agency Report (Q1 FY2026-27)
sum: JSW Cement files mandatory post-IPO utilization report covering June 2026 quarter, prepared by CRISIL Ratings as independent monitoring agency under SEBI disclosure rules.
implication: Quarterly monitoring reports are a standing compliance obligation for all listed IPO issuers; this filing confirms JSW Cement's adherence to SEBI's fund-utilization disclosure regime and provides visibility to markets on IPO proceeds deployment.
detail: JSW Cement Limited has filed its Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended 30 June 2026, as mandated under Regulation 41 of the SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 and Regulation 32 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. CRISIL Ratings Limited acts as the independent monitoring agency. This quarterly disclosure is routine post-IPO governance, tracking how IPO proceeds are deployed against the objects stated in the prospectus. The report was filed with NSE on 13 August 2026.

framework.ref: SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018 - Regulation 41
framework.note: Mandatory for issuers to engage independent monitoring agency and file quarterly reports on utilization of IPO proceeds.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 - Regulation 32
framework.note: Requires listed entities to make timely disclosures of material facts and events; incorporates fund-utilization monitoring into ongoing listing compliance.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 - Section 62 (preferential issue) and Schedule VI (prospectus contents)
framework.note: Establishes framework for capital issuance; prospectus must detail intended use of proceeds, which monitoring agency verifies.
While not directly applicable to fund utilization, applies to all listed entities in respect of material non-public information regarding deployment of IPO proceeds.

framework.ref: NSE Listing Rules (adopted by JSW Cement as listing venue)
framework.note: Exchange-specific rules requiring timely filing and public disclosure of monitoring agency reports.

conditions: Quarterly monitoring by independent agency (CRISIL Ratings)
Filing within specified disclosure timelines post each quarter-end
approvals: Exchange (NSE) acceptance of monitoring agency report
structure.novel: No novel structure; this is standard post-IPO governance reporting.

triggers.note: Triggers mandatory appointment of monitoring agency and quarterly filing requirement for all IPO issuers.
Triggers timely disclosure obligation on listed entity to furnish reports to stock exchange.
